question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping's consolidated authority as General Secretary of the Chinese Communist Party, President, and Central Military Commission chairman underpins the 95.5% trader consensus that he will remain in power through the end of 2026. Term-limit changes years earlier removed formal succession pressure, while elite networks and repeated personnel purges have aligned top leadership around continuity ahead of the 21st Party Congress expected in 2027. No institutional challenges, public health disclosures, or elite defections have surfaced to shift this positioning in recent months. Traders assign low odds to rapid destabilization from economic pressures or external events, though an abrupt health crisis or sudden internal realignment remains a narrow theoretical pathway that could still alter the outcome before year-end.
